part1.desc: Verifies that the following top-level items can only be defined as public in the following commons modules (see import-rules check): - `static`: `s` - `const`: `cnst` - `struct`, `enum`, and `type` alias: `t` - `trait`: `t` and `ext_traits`

part2.desc: Verifies that files in the following commons modules only contains the following top-level items as public: - `s`: `static` - `cnst`: `const` - `t`: `struct`, `enum`, `type` alias, and `trait` - `ext_traits`: `trait` - `c`: `fn`
part2.exemption: Items restricted to a visibility that cannot escape the commons module (i.e. `pub(super)`)

new-check.rationale: We want consistent locations for all user defined items, and a consistent public surface coming from these locations.
